nom: Perricone MD High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally describe the serum as gentler than other retinols or prescription tretinoin, though one reviewer specifically found it not suited for sensitive skin and several others note mild tingling or under-eye sensitivity when starting out.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin, enlarged pores and dullness reports a brighter complexion, softened fine lines and smaller-looking pores with nightly use.
segments.oily: A reviewer with oily skin says the serum normalized oil production without making her feel dry, peeling or oily through the day.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin prone to hormonal acne around the chin found the serum helpful for both breakouts and early signs of aging.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 30s through 60s consistently report smoother texture, softer fine lines and wrinkles, and a brighter, more even tone after several weeks of regular use, though a few say results were too subtle or too early to judge.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as hydrating rather than drying compared to other retinols, but several report some dryness, flaking or scaling at first, with some cutting back to a few uses per week to manage it.
concerns.redness: A handful of reviewers experienced mild sensitivity, tingling, or a slight burning sensation, particularly around the eyes and mouth, though most describe the serum as non-irritating once their skin adjusted.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using the serum for sun spots and hyperpigmentation report noticeable fading and a more even skin tone within a few weeks.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers note fewer breakouts or clearer skin after adding the serum to their routine, including one who says she went months without one.

aspects.libelle: Little to no fragrance for most users
A few detect an unpleasant or medicinal scent
High-quality dark glass bottle with pump
Can cause initial peeling or flaking

extraits.texte: I replaced my usual serum with the Perricone MD High Potency Triple Retinol Serum and I haven't noticed any difference in my skin texture and appearance. 2 pumps is all you need to cover your neck and face and it applies easily and sinks into your skin without leaving a residue.

I received this product to try. I have used other PerriconeMd products before and this is great. I have oily skin and this product seemed to normalize that. I don't get oily through the day but I'm also not dry or peeling or anything like that. It works well with my makeup. Has a herbal scent. I feel like I need to try it longer to see the other effects but I do see that my complexion is clearer. And it seems like it's helped reduce the look of my pores. I took a star off for the scent- it doesn't last long but I'm not a fan.

extraits.titre: Good Product, Not for Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: This retinol works well and definitely makes my skin smoother, however, I wouldn't recommend it for people with sensitive skin. It is one of those products where you need to work your way up to using it more than once a week. It is easy to apply and I like that it feels like a serum. I would recommend this to friends/family.

I have been trying to find the best retinol for my skin and I believe I have! I have been using kiehl's for a while but always seemed heavy. I have combination skin, prone to hormonal acne around my chin/mouth and nearing 50 this helps it all!

I use this product nightly after cleansing and my toner. I am 44 years old with dry skin, enlarged pores and dullness. I noticed while using this nightly, when I wake up in the morning my skin has more of a glow, less fine lines and my pores are minimized. I love that it is gentler than my rx of trentinoin, which I have stopped using in favor of the Perricone. A little bit goes a long way. When i wake up, I do my regular routine: wash, toner, vitamin c serum, moisturizer and you MUST wear sunscreen.

extraits.titre: This is a really nice retinol+ serum!
extraits.texte: I've been using this for a few weeks now & I really, really love it! I like that it's got encapsulated retinol because that way it won't be as affected by oxygen, I also love that they it has 3 types of retinol. They also included Coenzyme Q10 for discoloration & Beta-Carotene for dullness, texture & to protect and boost the retinol. It's really helping fade my sunspots. I live at the beach and spend too much time outside, even with reapplying SPF regularly the sun definitely damaged my skin. This is one of the few skincare products that actually helps fade that damage & discoloration. I recently saw a lot of family members & several told me that my skin looked great! That is not a compliment I'm used to getting! I'll definitely keep buying this serum after I'm done with this one.

I had high hopes for the Perricone MD High Potency Retinol Recovery Serum, and it's safe to say it didn't disappoint! Since retinol is a key player in smoothing fine lines and improving skin texture, I was excited to see how this serum would work on some unevenness and early signs of aging I've started noticing. Right off the bat, I loved the lightweight texture – it absorbs quickly, leaving no sticky feeling behind, which is a big plus. At first, I was cautious, using it just a few nights a week since I know retinol can sometimes be intense, especially on my sensitive skin. I didn't experience any irritation, just a slight tingling on the first few uses, which told me it was working. After a few weeks, I began to see subtle improvements. My skin looked a bit smoother and brighter, and I noticed some softening of the fine lines around my eyes and mouth. I can see this serum becoming a staple in my routine, especially because it feels like a good balance of potent yet gentle retinol, which is hard to find. It's a splurge, but for anyone wanting visible anti-aging benefits without overwhelming their skin, it's a solid investment.
